warnings: World, route, warm-up, shader state and LOD cache must also match; these are not verified by this tool.

limits: Each run warms and records for 120 seconds at full Retina resolution.
Visual settings and final player coordinates match within the pair; normal sampled 20 TPS.
GC is the intended experiment variable; original mod and fixture binaries match.
Two route pairs in opposite order support an optional ZGC candidate; they do not establish a general-world benefit or solve worst-frame hitches.
Sampled RSS is not complete GPU/unified-memory usage; collector MXBean time is not pause time.
This is a private spectator flyover, separate from the user supplied gameplay capture.
